text: cc-dsh-notifier（DSH 插件，Web 和 TUI 客户端）：为 Windows 上的 DeepSeek Harness 会话提供原生桌面提醒。插件订阅会话及交互事件，将提醒转发到本机通知守护进程，并按 Web 浏览器或终端会话绑定窗口。主要功能包括权限请求和问题提醒、等待输入时通知、目标窗口聚焦时抑制通知，以及点击 Toast 返回对应会话。适合希望离开 DSH 窗口时仍能收到提醒的 Windows 用户。需要 Windows 10/11、Node.js 18+、Python 3 和 winrt 通知组件。

cc-dsh-notifier (DSH Web/TUI plugin) sends Windows desktop alerts for permission requests, questions, and sessions waiting for input. It suppresses alerts while the session window is focused and returns to the session when a toast is clicked. Requires Windows 10/11, Node.js 18+, Python 3, and WinRT.

cc-dsh-notifier 的功能「权限与提问提醒」：cc-dsh-notifier 的「权限与提问提醒」：DSH 会话发起权限请求或 ask_user_question 时转为桌面通知事件；提醒内容包括工具或问题摘要。
cc-dsh-notifier 的功能「等待输入通知」：cc-dsh-notifier 的「等待输入通知」：agent 状态从运行变为空闲时生成等待输入提醒，帮助用户在离开会话窗口时发现需要继续处理的会话。
cc-dsh-notifier 的功能「点击返回会话」：cc-dsh-notifier 的「点击返回会话」：用户点击 Windows Toast 后，通知代理尝试激活对应浏览器标签或会话窗口，便于回到触发提醒的 DSH 会话。
cc-dsh-notifier 的功能「聚焦时静默」：cc-dsh-notifier 的「聚焦时静默」：daemon 检查当前前台窗口及会话绑定窗口；目标会话仍处于聚焦状态时抑制 Toast，避免正在查看时重复打扰。
cc-dsh-notifier 使用 Windows WinRT Toast 和窗口桥接；非 Windows 平台会降级，通知不可用。需要本机 Python 与 winrt 通知组件。

English · 中文

cc-dsh-notifier raises a native Windows toast with sound when an agent needs your attention and you are not looking at its window. It serves Claude Code through its hook system and DeepSeek Harness through a small bundle plugin, sharing one daemon pipeline. Clicking a toast returns you to the session window. Zero third-party npm dependencies.

cc-dsh-notifier README · Features：| Feature | Description |
|---|---|
| Interruption events | Notifies on permission requests, questions, and waiting for input |
| Focus awareness | Suppresses notifications while the session window is focused; notifies only when it is not |
| Click-to-return | `SetForegroundWindow` targets the session window; browser tabs activate via CDP, with a UIA fallback |
| Multi-session | Each session binds its own window handle; toasts carry the session identity |
| Localized notifications | Toast text follows the Windows display language (`auto`) or a `language` setting (`zh`/`en`) |
| DeepSeek Harness | The `dsh-notifier` plugin covers web and tui profiles with one install |

cc-dsh-notifier README · Prerequisites：- Windows 10 or 11
- Node.js 18 or later
- Python 3 with the winrt packages: `pip install winrt-runtime winrt-Windows.UI.Notifications winrt-Windows.Data.Xml.Dom`

cc-dsh-notifier README · Install (Claude Code)：```bash
node scripts/install.mjs
```

The installer backs up `~/.claude/settings.json`, injects five hooks, registers the `cc-notifier` AppUserModelID, and writes the default config. Open a new Claude Code session afterwards.

cc-dsh-notifier README · Install (DeepSeek Harness)：**Recommended — download the tarball from the [latest release](https://github.com/baobaolaodie/cc-dsh-notifier/releases) and install it** (no repository clone, no credentials):

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add ./baobaolaodie-cc-dsh-notifier-0.1.5.tgz
dsh plugin --profile dsh-tui add ./baobaolaodie-cc-dsh-notifier-0.1.5.tgz
```

cc-dsh-notifier README · Install (DeepSeek Harness)：> **版本说明 / Version note**: 顶部徽章 `0.1.2` 是 root 包版本;上方 tarball 名 `0.1.5` 是 dsh 插件包版本,两者是两个独立的发布单元(en: top badge = root package, tarball = dsh plugin; independent release units).
**Alternative — git install** (clones the whole repository, zero config):

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:baobaolaodie/cc-dsh-notifier
dsh plugin --profile dsh-tui add github:baobaolaodie/cc-dsh-notifier
```

cc-dsh-notifier README · Install (DeepSeek Harness)：> GitHub Packages (`@baobaolaodie/cc-dsh-notifier`) exists as a maintainer convenience channel only: GitHub Packages' npm registry **always requires a `read:packages` token for downloads, even for public packages** (verified). Use the tarball or git install instead.

cc-dsh-notifier README · DeepSeek Harness：The plugin forwards dsh session events into the same pipeline. Web sessions bind to the browser window; tui sessions bind to the terminal window:

```bash
dsh web          # or: dsh --profile web
dsh-tui          # or: dsh --profile dsh-tui
```

cc-dsh-notifier README · Manual trigger (testing)：```bash
node scripts/test.mjs permission-request   # permission-request | ask-user-question | stop | session-start
```

Toasts are suppressed while the target window is focused, so switch away to observe them.

cc-dsh-notifier README · Configuration：| Key | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | `true` | Set to `false` to disable notifications globally |
| `dedupWindowMs` | `0` | Deduplication window (ms); `0` = no dedup; `>0` merges per session+type |
| `pythonPath` | empty | Absolute path of the toast interpreter (written by the installer); empty = `python` from PATH |
| `pollIntervalMs` | `10000` | Daemon window-poll period (ms) |
| `windowWhitelist` | `[]` | Browser process whitelist for dsh web binding/focus (e.g. `chrome.exe`/`msedge.exe`) |
| `sound` | `true` | Set to `false` to mute toast sound |
| `language` | `auto` | Toast language: `auto` (system display language, `zh-*`→zh, `en-*`→en, other/failure→en), `zh`, or `en` |

cc-dsh-notifier README · Architecture：An event-driven pipeline runs only while sessions are active. Claude Code hooks and the dsh plugin both produce the same normalized payloads; a resident daemon decides whether to notify, and a Python agent shows the toast: ```mermaid %%{init: {'theme': 'base', 'themeVariables': {'fontSize': '14px'}}}%% flowchart LR CC["Claude Code

cc-dsh-notifier README · Architecture：The daemon is single-instance: it wakes on demand, exits after 60 seconds of no sessions, and self-restarts when its code changes. Sessions re-register automatically after a daemon restart.

│   ├── daemon.mjs         # Resident process: sessions, focus, dedup

cc-dsh-notifier README · Tech Stack：| Layer | Technology | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| Runtime | Node.js 18+ (ESM) | Forwarder, daemon, plugin |
| Notifications | Python 3 + winrt | Windows toast rendering and activation |
| Window bridge | PowerShell 5.1 + C# helpers | Window enumeration, foreground query, CDP/UIA tab activation |
| Testing | node:test | Unit + integration tests |
